shortDefinition: A general-purpose AI system designed to help users with diverse tasks through conversation.
fullDefinition: An AI assistant is a conversational AI system designed to help with a wide range of tasks — writing, research, analysis, coding, brainstorming — without specializing in any single domain. ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini are all AI assistants. They differ from copilots (embedded in a specific tool) and agents (which take autonomous actions) in that they primarily respond to individual requests conversationally.
